exposure: Maternal weight gain by 18 weeks' gestation
Family socioeconomic status at time of birth
cohort: The study included 1,170 adolescent offspring aged 17 years participating in the Western Australian Pregnancy (Raine) Cohort Study.
finding: Early-life contributors to NAFLD show considerable sexual dimorphism, with maternal obesity and higher early-mid gestational weight gain associated with NAFLD in female offspring, and lower family socioeconomic status at birth associated with NAFLD in male offspring, independent of adolescent obesity.
